detail: Full summary: While fixing the stdout protocol check the lane added 2>/dev/null to the CLI invocation and silently swallowed every stderr diagnostic (the 'cannot inject' / 'could not parse' notes); two existing hook tests caught it and it was restored with a comment naming the trap.
